agent_prompt:
CONTEXT:
- Project: NorthGuard governed chat surface (E5), now decomposed (DECISION-REGISTER §8 A1). Tech: React SPA (Vite), TypeScript strict, Vitest.
- AUTHORITATIVE SPEC: prototype/NorthGuard Handoff.md — state inventory §1.1, timings §2. Where the Handoff and the prototype HTML disagree, the Handoff wins for behaviour, the HTML for pacing.
- Current state: US-037 (motion/design tokens) and US-036 (i18n) are done this sprint; import them. The E3 core (InspectionVerdict) exists.

TASK:
Implement US-032 (AF-501): the composer state machine — the interaction spine of the surface.

CREATE FILES: per manifest.create. Signatures exactly per specs/EP-05-chat-surface/APP-FUNCTIONS.md (AF-501).

RULES:
1. TDD first. The composerReducer test MUST cover every edge in the Handoff §1.1 table (idle/typing/inspecting/clean/touched/blocked/report/report-done/degraded/locked).
2. Timings come from AF-506 motion tokens, never hardcoded: 600 ms typing pause → inspecting; inspection sweep runs ≥ 400 ms even if the verdict is faster; a keystroke during inspecting aborts to typing.
3. Send during typing AUTO-SENDS on a clean verdict but STOPS on redact/block (never auto-send a finding).
4. 'locked' until E2 areas are confirmed — no forward (NG-3). 'degraded' overlays any state when the backstop is down and is never hidden (NG-4).
5. The composer stores state + the last verdict only; ComposerView is always derived (deriveComposerView), never stored.
6. Do NOT modify core/** or the sibling mirror/reply packages (protected) — only reserve the mirror slot in the grid (rows 0fr↔1fr so the layout never jumps).
7. Report tests after each pair; final summary must show the full transition table green and the auto-send-on-clean vs stop-on-touch behaviour.
